div.div:
Error policy
• SystemException → retry (RPA_MAX_RETRIES = 3)
• BusinessException → no retry
• Every failed attempt: screenshot + log
• Browser always closed in finally

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 238px; height: 1px; padding-top: 517px; margin-left: 12px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Layering rules
1. Dependencies only point down.
2. Tasks never contain locators.
3. Pages never call other pages and hold no business logic.
4. Only core/engines/ imports Selenium or Playwright.
5. Tasks share data only through context.
6. process.py defines the task order.
Locator prefixes
BTN_ TXT_ LBL_ LNK_ CHK_
RDO_ DDL_ TBL_ MDL_ IFR_
CSS first · xpath= only if needed
Never time.sleep()
